main_text.p: In epitome trimembri Lutheranæ theologiæ: part. 2.ob eamque caufam, nec certum caput libri, quem admodum foleo, notabam; & subiiciebam, ut {a}Fridericus Staphylus citat: qui si officiose catholicæ fidei zelo mentiendum censuit, peccatum quidem veniale est, sed ipsius, non meum: nos, quæcunque faciunt ad Lutheranorum odium, libenter undecunque conquirimus, & obiicimus; verè an falsò scripta sint, à testibus fide dignis an sycophantis, haud laboramus. Omnino ista mente videtur Iesuita Friderici Staphyli citatio-nem intexendo cavisse sibi ipsi: vir dignissimus (nonne?) qui cum in tenebris mices. Namque in speciem, præsertim nimis credulis lectoribus, hoc dicit: Errorem habet Lutherus prælectionibus in Genesin, ut Fridericus Staphylus, illius verba citans, indicat. Re autem vera diligentius inquirentibus ait: Staphylus de Lutheri prælectionibus in Genesin mentitur; sed mendacium commodè faciens pro nobis; & fidem inventurum, si ex eo citemus caute; quis enim tantum opus Lutheri evolvet, ut redarguat? Præclaro documento quam cunctanter fides adhibenda sit, vel assensio potius prudenter cohibenda ab iis quæ Pontificii de nostris asseverant. Etenim, si Staphylus, Regis Romanorum (ut se inscribit) Consiliarius, tam in-verecunde mentiri ausus est: quid non ausuros putas esurientes Græculos, Bolsecos, Surios, Genebrardos? Si falsa prædicare de scriptis, de operibus excusis, non verentur, in quibus vanitatis ex evi-dentia rei facile convincuntur: quid reformida-bunt de factis, aut dictis; quorum vel perpau-ci[?], vel nulli testes sunt? page.notes: Mark {a} stands in the text before "Fridericus" with no matching printed note in the margin; it may belong to a note cut off or not visible on this scan. The running head "idololatria" ends in a letter that is hard to make out at this resolution; read as "idololatria". "perpau-ci" is uncertain: the line-end letters are faint. "mices" is copied as printed and may be a printing error. The small superscript "a" below the last line at the lower right is not read as a signature and is left out; "Me-" is taken as the catchword. The "*" note is placed at the line where its mark stands. The page starts mid-sentence, so the paragraph is marked cont="true".
